item.title: POJO (Plain Old Java Object): The simpler...the better.
item.description: A POJO is simply an object built using a Java class that does not implement any special interfaces such as those defined by the EJB 2 framework. An example of a POJO is a class composed by only: 1. Properties, representing the object's state. 2. Getter and setter methods for the properties. 3.…
